item.title: Palazzo San Felice
item.description:
Verso la futura Biblioteca di Archeologia e Storia dell’Arte | Exhibitions - Software development | 2025

Remote control and management system for video streaming and video projectors

Stack: Go, Python, React JS, PostgreSQL

Il progetto di curatela e l’allestimento analogico e digitale del percorso di visita è stato affidato, su incarico dell’Agenzia del Demanio - ente attuatore del progetto di ristrutturazione di Palazzo San Felice - e in accordo con la Presidenza della Repubblica e il Ministero della Cultura, a un team di ricercatori e designer del Centro di ricerca e servizi Saperi&Co della Sapienza, guidati da Carlo Martino, docente di Design, e Luca Ruzza, docente di Discipline dello spettacolo, e composto da Gaia Casaldi, Carlotta Belluzzi Mus, Anna Turco, Daniela Dispoto e Donato Locantore.

item.title: Copernicus Emergency Management Service
item.description:
External Consultant - Senior Software Developer | Joint Research Centre (JRC), Ispra | Copernicus Emergency Management Service, E1 Floods

Software analysis and development for Web/GIS applications supporting the Copernicus Emergency Management Service flood systems.

I work on the development and maintenance of EFAS and GloFAS websites and other web applications in the Floods section, contributing GIS, backend, frontend, and operational development expertise.

I also developed and manage the Global Flood Partnership website.

item.title: Cantieri della Civiltà Marinara
item.description:
Porto San Giorgio | Exhibitions - Software development | 2020

Remote control and management system for video streaming and video projectors

Stack: Go, Python, React JS, PostgreSQL

Linea Blu a Porto San Giorgio puntata del 17 ottobre 2020

Il recente accordo di collaborazione stipulato dall’Istituto Centrale per il Patrimonio Immateriale (ICPI) con il Comune di Porto San Giorgio ha portato in brevissimo tempo alla realizzazione di un polo dedicato al patrimonio culturale immateriale dell’Adriatico centrale, un nuovo attrattore turistico-culturale per la città e per l’intero territorio regionale. Lo spazio, all’interno del Palazzo Trevisani, nel centro storico di Porto San Giorgio, è diviso in tre sezioni: il Fortunale, il Porto dei Suoni e Onda volubile.

item.title: Skills
item.description:
GIS Systems

I have strong experience in GIS and Web GIS systems, working with MapServer, GeoServer, PostGIS, QGIS, and frontend mapping libraries such as OpenLayers and Leaflet.

My work includes spatial data modeling, geospatial data processing, map publication services, interactive map interfaces, and integration with standards and formats such as WMS, WFS, GeoJSON, and NetCDF.

As an external consultant at the Joint Research Centre (JRC) in Ispra, I work on the Copernicus Emergency Management Service, E1 Floods section, contributing to EFAS, GloFAS, and related web applications.

item.title: About
item.description:
I design and build web, GIS, and AI-assisted systems for data-driven projects, public institutions, cultural organizations, and interactive installations.

My strongest area of specialization is geospatial software: Web GIS platforms, spatial data pipelines, MapServer, GeoServer, PostGIS, QGIS, and interactive map interfaces.

I work as an external consultant and senior software developer at the Joint Research Centre (JRC) in Ispra for the Copernicus Emergency Management Service, E1 Floods section. I contribute to the development and maintenance of EFAS and GloFAS websites and other web applications, collaborating with ECMWF-hosted repositories and workflows.
